notes.title: OVERALL THE BALL IS ON KICKSTARTER – WE NEED YOU!
notes.content:
🎉 IT’S LIVE! OVERALL THE BALL is now on KICKSTARTER! 🎉  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993777/68ba3664746d2d00cd99dfd24177d93615c5add9.png"]

And we need your help to take it to the next level! 💪

After months of passion, hard work, and laughter (and way too many "one more bug fix" nights), our chaotic, stylish party fighter is finally ready to step into the spotlight. But we can't do it alone — we need YOU on the field! 🔥


🔗 Kickstarter campaign link
👉 https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/48302451/overall-the-ball-an-ultra-nervous-party-game




💥 Why back us?
Help us bring the full vision of the game to life: more characters, more maps, more madness!  

Get exclusive rewards




❤️ Your support means everything.
This game is the project of a lifetime. And it’s only with your help that we can make it shine.

Whether you back us, share the campaign, or just spread the word—thank you. Truly.

We’re counting on you.



#Kickstarter #OverallTheBall #IndieGame #SupportIndies #PartyFighter
